hooks.command: if command -v orbit-mem >/dev/null 2>&1; then orbit-mem hook pre-tool --host claude --plugin-version 0.15.0; fi

if command -v orbit-mem >/dev/null 2>&1; then orbit-mem hook session-start --host claude --plugin-version 0.15.0; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"additionalContext":"orbit-mem 실행 파일이 PATH에 없습니다. https://github.com/onidot-labs/orbit-mem 안내대로 설치한 뒤 `orbit-mem install`을 실행하세요.","hookEventName":"SessionStart"}}'; fi
if command -v orbit-mem >/dev/null 2>&1; then orbit-mem hook subagent-start --host claude --plugin-version 0.15.0; fi
if command -v orbit-mem >/dev/null 2>&1; then orbit-mem hook prompt --host claude --plugin-version 0.15.0; fi
